name: Suntec Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: Suntec Real Estate Investment Trust (Suntec REIT) is a real estate investment trust that invests primarily in income-producing real estate used for commercial purposes in Singapore and Australia. Its portfolio includes office and retail properties such as Suntec City, and it aims to provide stable returns to its investors through rental income and capital appreciation. The trust is managed by an external manager and listed on the Singapore Exchange.
